text: Code reviews are an important practice in software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the software is released. This saves time and money because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also help with knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other and understand different parts of the project. As a result, the whole team becomes stronger. In addition, regular code reviews improve team quality. Everyone follows the same rules and writes cleaner code. In short, code reviews are not just about finding mistakes. They help teams work better together and produce better software.
